study: Gold V2.2: forward-pricing around already-known US Treasury Bill settlements and pre-scheduled US tax dates

research_window.selection: only US Treasury Bill announced offerings and known old auction maturity amounts as of decision date, or preset calendar tax date
research_window.decision_time: 00:00 UTC on T-k business weekday; only information dated no later than T-k-1 calendar day
research_window.event_boundary: 00:00 UTC on settlement calendar date; not verified actual intraday cash-settlement time

limitations: Known gross Treasury Bill offering less auction-original maturing awarded principal is NOT actual TGA net change
KNOWN MATURITIES WITHOUT A PUBLICLY ANNOUNCED REPLACEMENT BILL are source-incomplete: no signed gold-direction proxy is calculated for them
Events selected by ex-ante known announcement; never by later actual realized TGA magnitude
Midmonth tax-date calendar is approximate and carries NO implied direction or magnitude
Yahoo continuous GC=F proxy prices are NOT exchange-certified COMEX fills; returns are unlevered raw market changes with no transaction costs
Cashflow-driven directional adjusted returns represent a noncausal hypothesis, NOT tradeable alpha
Event cohorts and gold trends overlap; no independent-trade win rate can be inferred
Treasury source history current-vintage; actual historical publication timestamps and auction revisions remain unverified
The 00UTC event-time split may not coincide with intraday Treasury cash settlement
No macro dollar-real-yield-Fed COMEX CFTC full gold V2.2 A/A+/A++ confirmations or risk adjusted trade PnL have been inferred

limits: Research price effects are NOT V2.2 actual trade returns or full TGA predictions
Selection uses calendar-known gross Bill offering minus known old maturity, not ex post TGA changes
Tax-date cohort is date-only with unknown shock direction, kept separate
Gold event boundary is UTC midnight; actual settlement intraday timing unverified
Conservative 1-calendar-day lag for announcements, 2 for accepted auction results; archival release versions not verified
Gold GC=F continuous series does not model COMEX contract rolls, slippage, margin or brokerage costs
Multiple event horizons overlap, so sample counts cannot be treated as independent trades
Year 2025 and 2026 were previously examined during research; this is NOT an untouched out-of-sample test
